evidenceLimitations: Two real automatic boundaries exist only in this single case; the ordinary resume is not another automatic round.
R1 and R2 Read different round-specific files (r1-a.txt and r2-a.txt); this is repeated Read workflow, not evidence of re-reading the same filename.
Each request used the fake-key loopback mock. Its large token counter and 20 percent control force compaction; they do not establish real provider billing or a natural trigger threshold.
No OS egress firewall was applied; this source does not prove absence of every possible background connection.
Selected requests omit SDK system and Read tool schemas plus unrelated reminder bodies; raw requests and raw SSE remain only in the recorded temporary source directory.
Prior R1 file56 reinjection is observed only after R2 S55, and is the earlier receipt rather than the current-round receipt. No generalized file selection/order/layout is inferred.
Dual first-round results completed in reverse order and failed required old public ACK. There is no repeated dual native evidence.
